description_en: Queries the business statistics of a namespace by calling GetNamespaceStatisticsData
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc get-namespace-statistics-data --project-id PIY3UB0T --namespace cc6c29893f2be7d465db44ec7b5d593e --dimension-type 101 --start-time 2018-09-20 --end-time 2018-09-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNamespaceStatisticsData

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the namespace
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The statistical dimension type.

101: daily active users
102: daily active devices
103: data submission count
111: per-minute user access count
112: per-minute device access count
113: per-minute data submission count
parameters.help_zh:
统计维度类型。

101-用户日活
102-设备日活
103-数据提交次数
111-每分钟用户访问次数
112-每分钟设备访问次数
113-每分钟数据提交次数
parameters.name: dimension_type

parameters.help_en:
The start time.

For daily statistics, such as 2018-08-16.
For per-minute statistics, such as 2018-08-23 13:53
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time.

For daily statistics, such as 2018-08-16.
For per-minute statistics, such as 2018-08-23 13:53
parameters.name: end_time
